shots.name: trap
shots.evalScript: (function(){var w=function(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms)})};var b=document.getElementById('bespoke');var deck=document.getElementById('deck');function id(){var a=deck.querySelectorAll('.sheet');return a[1]?a[1].getAttribute('data-i'):'?'}function wheel(dy){var e=new WheelEvent('wheel',{deltaY:dy,bubbles:true,cancelable:true});deck.dispatchEvent(e);return e.defaultPrevented}return (async function(){window.scrollTo(0,b.offsetTop);await w(1600);var log=[['y',Math.round(scrollY),'active',id()]];for(var i=0;i<7;i++){var p=wheel(120);await w(430);log.push(['down'+i,'prevented',p,'active',id(),'y',Math.round(scrollY)])}var pLast=wheel(120);await w(400);log.push(['downAtLast','prevented',pLast,'active',id(),'y',Math.round(scrollY)]);for(var j=0;j<7;j++){wheel(-120);await w(430)}var pFirst=wheel(-120);await w(400);log.push(['upAtFirst','prevented',pFirst,'active',id(),'y',Math.round(scrollY)]);return JSON.stringify(log)})()})()
